landing.heroTitle: Manage your team without the pressure.
landing.heroSubtitle: SirRelay helps small teams stay aligned — one clear task at a time, on the web or Telegram. No dashboards, no performance metrics, no noise.
landing.demoCaption: One task in focus — the next one arrives when the current one is done.
landing.featuresLead: You run the work. Your team sees what matters now — not a wall of KPIs.

simple.title: Simple to run
simple.body: Create teammates, assign tasks, and follow progress on a clean board or list. Operators see everything; teammates see only their queue.

calm.title: No metric pressure
calm.body: No leaderboards, velocity charts, or surveillance-style stats. Tasks and due dates — that's it. Your team works, not performs.

relay.title: One task at a time
relay.body: On Telegram, teammates receive a single active task. Mark it done and the next one arrives automatically — focused relay, not overload.

what.a: A calm task relay for small groups — web for the full picture, Telegram for one task at a time.

groups.a: Create an account, start a group or accept an invite. Tasks and members live inside each group.

metrics.a: No. No leaderboards, velocity charts, or surveillance KPIs — just tasks, due dates, and relay.

telegram.a: No for admins. Members work best with Telegram for the one-task-at-a-time relay; web always shows the same state.

data.a: On SirRelay servers (PostgreSQL). Signed-in pages are never cached by the browser; the session uses one essential cookie.
